content: Hi, I wrote up a four-part blog tutorial mostly aimed at tactics, demonstrated on concrete examples in synthetic Euclidean geometry: https://www.vladasedlacek.cz/en/posts/lean-01-intro. I struggled with finding some of the parts elsewhere, so I hope it will be useful. I'm still a Lean beginner though, so if you spot any mistakes/inefficiencies, please let me know.
